I do understand why this clinic has a lot of 5 stars. The vet’s supporting staff is outstanding. They truly care about our fur babies and treat them with the utmost love and affection. Whitney and Toni are rock stars! Unfortunately, that is the only stellar quality they possess. If you prefer to handle your everyday life electronically and prefer affordable pet care services, this clinic is not for you. Not only are their services priced higher than most in the area, but their administration is also sorely lacking. If you prefer to go to Chewy for your pet’s prescription needs, it is a hassle to get that to happen. One huge problem for me is the experience of filling prescriptions. You will have to get them to print the prescription which you have to pick up (they will not mail it) and then you have to mail it to Chewy. My fur baby is waiting on special meds, and I have to go through the hassle when it could have been done in a click of a button. For me, good customer service would allow for flexibility. They are inflexible about it. I understand they want to sell you everything through their own online pharmacy (you will have to pay to get it delivered, too), but it would be nice if it was affordable or competitive. Other administrative issues like not returning a call, mailing something to the incorrect address, and errors with appointment setting also have occurred more than once...

All in all, I would suggest looking elsewhere for your pet’s wellness. The administrative hassles and high pricing unfortunately outweigh the medical staff's love and care.

Dr. Becker and her team were absolutely amazing! They helped me with all the paperwork and requirements to bring my cat to Spain, while reassuring this very anxious cat mom that everything would be okay :)

Everything went smoothly, and I had no issues at the airport. Thank you so much for all your help! Bobo and I are happily together in Spain now, and I’m so grateful!
The doctors are attentive, skilled, and empathetic.  Highly recommend!
10/10 cat specialists. It's super quiet and calming here and they have different treatment options!
The only place I will take my baby. The staff is so knowledgeable, attentive, and it’s the first vet I fully trust. The prices are extremely fair for their knowledge and level of care.

My cat boo suddenly became very aggressive, with no real obvious signs or causes. Due to the situation, I decided it was better to go to a vet that specialized in cats in hopes theyd understand her better. The staff were incredibly patient and understanding with the situation, and were great once I brought her in. Their bedside manners for an incredibly senstive time was unmatched, which is something I have struggled with in the past at other vets. My cat boo is already showing signs of improvement and I am so greatful for Houston Cat Hospital in helping my kitty I know and love return back to her normal self

What an amazing expierence! Our cat threw up a lot and started to foam at the mouth. We called the Houston Cat Hospital and they said bring her in right away. They saw us immediately. Toni, was wonderful! A calm knowledge  kind presence. She made us feel very confident in the next steps to treat our little girl.

We found out she had an upper respiratory sickness. After giving her the prescription medication she is now sneezing and coughing less, and almost completely to her normal self and it's only been a few days.

Moving forward we are transferring our cats care here fully.

Overall the expierence for our cat was the best of any vet since this facility only services cats. She normally has anxiety with dogs and this proved to us a vet visit can be stress free.

This is my first cat and I wanted the best for him so we take him here. The entire staff is very friendly and informative. They take such great care of my Kino especially when he’s very scared. Top tier care!!

Houston Cat Hospital has been amazing. The staff is so caring, compassionate, and professional.
They truly take the time to listen and make both you and your cat feel comfortable. I appreciate how gentle and patient they are.  The clinic is also very clean, calm, and well-maintained, which creates such a comforting environment for both pets and owners. Dr. Becker is incredibly knowledgeable, thorough, and compassionate. She takes the time to explain everything clearly and you can tell she genuinely cares about her patients and their wellbeing. The entire team goes above and beyond to provide excellent care, and I'm very grateful for the kindness they've shown my Gala!   I highly recommend Houston Cat Hospital to anyone looking for a feline-focused veterinary clinic in Houston.

I took LouLou to Houston Cat Hospital yesterday morning, and honestly, I can’t say enough good things about our experience. I actually thought I had booked an appointment at a cat hospital in Montrose, but when my GPS kept telling me I was going the wrong way, I realized I had accidentally scheduled at a location about 25 minutes farther than I expected. By the time I figured it out, I was running late, it was raining, I had a full day of Friday meetings ahead of me, and I was completely flustered. I immediately called the office to let them know I was going to be about 18 minutes late. The woman who answered the phone was incredibly kind. I think she could hear the panic in my voice because she immediately reassured me and said, “It’s alright. We’ll see LouLou when you get here.” That simple act of kindness instantly lowered my stress level.
I made my appointment online and was very detailed in the section asking what was wrong. I included symptoms, treatments I’d already tried, and information from previous veterinarians. You know what impressed me? When I arrived, everyone already knew LouLou’s story. Nobody asked the dreaded, “So what brings you in today?” question that makes you repeat everything you already spent 20 minutes typing. It genuinely felt like the team had reviewed her case beforehand and talked about the patients coming in that day.
From the moment we walked in, every single person greeted us by name. Everyone stopped what they were doing to say good morning and welcome us. That level of personal attention is rare these days. Our veterinary technician, Toni, was absolutely purr-fect for the job (see what I did there? 😉). She was gentle, compassionate, and so patient with LouLou. You could immediately tell she genuinely loves animals. Dr. Rodriguez was incredibly thorough. She never made us feel rushed and took the time to really investigate what might be causing LouLou’s issues. Rather than jumping straight to expensive testing and treatments, she suggested a conservative approach first and scheduled a follow-up in two weeks. What impressed me even more was what happened afterward. When Toni brought in the treatment plan, I suggested adding something that had come up during our conversation. Instead of immediately agreeing and increasing the bill, she told me, “No, that’s something we’ll try if this doesn’t work. There’s no reason to add cost if we don’t need to.” How often do you hear that anymore? She was genuinely looking out for me and making sure I wasn’t spending money unnecessarily. I also had the opportunity to meet another technician, Whitney (I apologize if I’m remembering the name incorrectly), who came in to help with LouLou’s allergy testing. She was so sweet, giving LouLou extra attention, affection, and reassurance while helping distract her during the blood draw. I truly appreciated it. At no point did I feel like anyone was rushing through the appointment or handling LouLou roughly. Everyone treated her with patience, kindness, and genuine affection. You can tell this team loves what they do. It’s written all over their faces.There are several veterinary clinics much closer to my home, but after this experience, I’ll gladly make the drive. In fact, all four of my cats will be coming here from now on. Thank you for fitting us in the very next day after I made the appointment. Thank you for being understanding when I was late. And thank you for turning what could have been a stressful morning into such a positive experience.

LouLou and I are incredibly grateful. -Cynthia

HCA has been a life saver. For the past few years, my 14 year old cat Maya had been marking/urinating outside the litter box, showing signs of heat, lost a large amount of weight, and had high blood pressure. I had taken her to several vets, including Lighthouse Veterinary Clinic and Sunset Animal Hospital, and they all were quite dismissive of my description of her symptoms and just told me to give her anxiety medication. I knew something was wrong, and HCA was my last resort. If you have a cat, I highly recommend taking them here, especially for serious health problems, because the difference I noticed was immediate. The atmosphere was calm and quiet, the staff were friendly, and Dr. Becker really went above and beyond to find the problem. They even gave Maya some cat treats that she went crazy for! They eventually discovered a tumor near her adrenal gland and recommended surgery. I am writing this post surgery, with Maya recovered completely and back to her old self. It’s like a miracle, and I’m so grateful to HCA for truly listening.

The staff are so kind, knowledgeable, professional, and patient. The care my cat receives here is amazing. Most of the vets I’ve been too previously seem to focus primarily on dogs (even the emergency vet), so I was very relieved to find the Houston Cat Hospital. Can’t recommend highly enough.

Really professional and gentle with our cat.

The staff at the Cat Hospital was so kind. It was wonderful to have a place that specialized in cats only. It was so calm. No big scary dogs. Our kitty was as chill as a cat can be in those circumstances

I have mixed feelings about this place. Maybe it’s just the utter grief talking, but I’m disappointed. We took our cat in to see them in July 2025. I noticed she had a huge appetite still, but was losing weight. We did bloodwork and they suggested to do more bloodwork, but honestly, I feel like they should have suggested imaging back then, because maybe just maybe, we would have found her tumor earlier.

After feeling a lump on her side in late November 2025, we took her in, in December and were told the devastating news. She had a tumor and by how quickly it had grown, we were told she was most likely at the end stage.

Over the last few months, we took her periodically to HCH to get fluid drained, since she was retaining fluid quite a bit. I am grateful for this, because I truly feel like this procedure helped our girl to stay with us a little longer.

Unfortunately, we had to put our sweet girl to rest on Monday. She fought a valiant fight and we loved and love her so dearly, but honestly, I can’t help but wonder if images would have shown more 8 months ago. Maybe yes, maybe no, but I just wonder.

Also, I don’t feel like communication has always been great. We’ve called about different things, and don’t always get a response in a timely manner.

One last thing, just gonna say it, we haven’t even heard from the office since our girl’s passing. I know it’s only been a couple of days,  but it would have been nice to receive a text, email, something. I don’t know if this is typical, it’s been awhile since we’ve lost a pet, but would have been nice.

Also, be aware, any medication given at places like this is incredibly less expensive when you get it on Chewy or a comparable website. Be aware of that.

i was in a very stressful and frustrating situation being a first time cat mom, but EVERYONE here was very helpful and comforting. i waited 45 emotional minutes full of tears and worries at the alief animal hospital after being told “you won’t have to wait nearly an hour”. i called the cat hospital and they told me to come in right away! as i am walking out and leaving to go to the cat hospital the vet that was just standing behind the desk for 10 minutes suddenly is ready to see my kitten. there was more than this that were red flags, but this is what solidified me never going back and never recommending the alief animal hospital. gave them both the same spiel about what was happening and how my baby was BLEEDING from his nose..but the vets, techs, and receptionists all just seemed to care more at the cat hospital. regardless of how major or “minor” the problem(s) might turn out to be the urgency is always wanted and appreciated. brittany, viany, dr. becker, and whitney were so so kind. dr. becker constantly reassured me and consistently let me know everything that she was doing or going to do. i was given recommendations and options with it all explained to me if needed and not just handed a piece of paper and left to figure it out. wish they could take all pets. if you want piece of mind come here. my baby is feeling so much better!!

If you’re looking for a place that sees your cat as more than a chart, this is it. Ask for Ana, at the front desk; or any of them, really. They’ll walk with you, not around you.

I have been a pretty consistent customer and I had a very good experience last year when I brought my cat here for similar symptoms as she experienced this visit. Both last year and this one, was scratching excessively and also not eating properly. I came by because they quickly resolved the issue without incident. Their prices were reasonable and the service was good.

Unfortunately, the atmosphere changed. I had to bring her in twice to resolve her issues. After spending $1153 on the various tests, over two separate visits, I belive that the process could have been handled better. Beneath the veneer of supposedly caring about animals  it felt like that they were really interested generating the largest possible bill.  The first time, they told me that I had to do blood work to give a proper assessment of what was going on. For a total of $380, I acquiesced since I hadn’t looked at it in a year. I had to request the results as they did not automatically provide them to me. The doctors evaluation had jumped from $75 to 90. I understand that the cost of living has risen, so I was not going to dispute that charge. Since they could not get urine from her, they sent me home with flea medications and a home urine test kit.

After a couple of days, I had to return since the she had completely stopped eating. Instead of attacking the symptom of her appetite, they went on to suggest that she needed to have additional testing done for pancreatitis and medicine for pain, blood testing. The pancreatis test cost $172.  I was also charged $68 for an additional visit, which frankly, I thought should have been waived as the cat was being brought on for the same symptoms that were unresolved.  They sent me home with additional medications which included an appetite stimulant, which is what she needed in the first place.

I am not going to give this place 1 star since the cat is doing a lot better She isn’t scratching and is eating, however, I think that they could listen to their customers better.  They should have provided the appetite stimulant at the outset  instead ordering what ultimately were costly and unnecessary tests. I am disappointed, but mostly with myself for not seeing this coming.
